pageDescription: Craft CMS, Payload CMS and Next.js platform work for the Fidium Fiber family of websites.
fbOgSiteName: A Fort Worth based developer who makes unique web experiences.
workHeroImageAlt: Family playing video games together on a couch at home
workDescription: One shared content platform, built for a family of distinct websites. At Amdocs, I led development of the headless Craft CMS behind the Fidium ecosystem and built Next.js and React experiences for Fidium Fiber, Business, Wholesale, Partners and Consolidated Communications.
workNarrative: I built a bespoke page editor, page builder and custom Craft modules, with GraphQL APIs delivering content to seven Next.js applications. My responsibility extended beyond launch: maintaining content integrity, supporting the applications from the CMS side and developing solutions as technical issues arose. The broader platform work also included Payload CMS.

Across the sites, I maintained reusable components, hooks and webhooks, with Jest tests and Storybook documentation. I configured Nginx reverse proxies and supported dev, QA, staging and production deployments through GitLab CI/CD, working with engineering, marketing, IT and cloud teams.
The five sites below show how that shared foundation supports different audiences: residential customers, businesses, wholesale customers, partners and existing Consolidated customers.
workHighlights: Built the headless Craft CMS (bespoke editor, GraphQL, custom modules) that serves content for 7 sites.
Redesigned and launched Next.js apps for Fidium Fiber, Business, Partners, Wholesale, Consolidated and fidium.net.
Maintained a shared UI toolkit of components, hooks and webhooks, tested with Jest and documented in Storybook.
Configured Nginx reverse proxies to serve several sites from one repo, across dev, QA, stage and production on GitLab CI/CD.
workRole: Software Engineer, Lead Craft CMS Developer, React/Next.js Developer
workTechnology: Craft CMS, Payload CMS, Next.js, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Storybook, Jest, Nginx, GitLab CI/CD, Amazon Web Services (SES, S3, RDS)
